scripts.prebuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const src=path.join(__dirname,'../data/raw-zone/data_quality_reports'); const dest=path.join(__dirname,'public/reports'); if(fs.existsSync(src)){ fs.mkdirSync(dest,{recursive:true}); fs.readdirSync(src).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.html')).forEach(f=>fs.copyFileSync(path.join(src,f),path.join(dest,f))); }"
